### Problem Description
A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

### Steps to Reproduce

2. Scan barcode or tap '...'
3. See error or freeze

- **Scanner Mode**: [e.g. Tera 0013 BLE / HID Wedge / Camera / None]
- **Device**: [e.g. Android Pixel 6a / iPad / Laptop Chrome]

### Expected Behavior
A concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots / Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or console output.
